indicesNarrative: Major indices are attempting to stabilize in pre-market trade after three consecutive down sessions led by tech and semiconductors. Upward momentum remains capped by the 10-year Treasury yield pressing past 5.00% and WTI crude pushing above $101/bbl ahead of the FOMC policy decision. Breadth remains defensive with defensive sectors and cash finding relative bids over high-multiple growth.
technicalsNarrative: SPY, QQQ, and DIA have pulled back into FAIR entry-risk territory near their rising 50-day moving averages after retreating from extended highs. Daily MACD histograms across all three major indexes are falling and curving downward, confirming momentum has cooled significantly. With RSI hovering in the mid-40s and negative momentum divergences active, buying breakouts carry elevated failure risk until the 50-day EMAs are defended with volume.
